headline: Albemarle Earnings Jump 3,300%. Commodity Prices Helped.
summary: Wall Street was looking for earnings per share of $3.20 from sales of $1.6 billion, up from a comparable EPS of 11 cents and sales of $1.3 billion in the second quarter of 2025.  Things are a lot better year over year because commodity prices are up.  Through Wednesday trading, Albemarle stock was down 16% year to date and up 74% over the past 12 months.
